request: scale a recipe: it serves 4 and uses 300 g flour, I want to cook for 6

replies.reply: {"kind": "answer", "text": "For 6 servings from a 4-serving recipe, multiply everything by 1.5 — so 300 g flour becomes 450 g flour.", "brief": "", "search": "none", "image": ""}
For 6 servings, multiply the 4-serving recipe by 1.5. So 300 g flour becomes 450 g flour.
